'Grand Theft Auto Online' Update Adds Triple Rewards on Slasher Modes and Halloween Survivals, Double Rewards on UFO Business Battles, and More

by Rainier on Oct. 1, 2026 @ 9:49 a.m. PDT

Set in the sprawling city of Los Santos and the surrounding area, Grand Theft Auto V delivers a world of unprecedented scale and detail bursting with life, from mountaintops to the depths of the ocean.

When a young street hustler, a retired bank robber and a terrifying psychopath find themselves entangled with some of the most frightening and deranged elements of the criminal underworld, the U.S. government and the entertainment industry, they must pull off a series of dangerous heists to survive in a ruthless city in which they can trust nobody, least of all each other.

Switch between the interconnected lives of Michael, Trevor and Franklin as they embark on a series of heists across Los Santos and Blaine County in the biggest, deepest and richest open world experience yet, with game world enhancements that include new wildlife, upgraded weather and damage effects, and an array of new details to discover.

Grand Theft Auto V also comes with Grand Theft Auto Online, the dynamic and ever-evolving online universe for up to 30 players, and includes all existing gameplay upgrades and content released since the launch of Grand Theft Auto Online.

Rise through the ranks to become a CEO of your own criminal empire by trading contraband or form a Motorcycle Club and rule the streets. Pull off daring co-operative Heists, enter adrenaline-fueled Stunt Races, compete in unique Adversary Modes or create your own content to play and share with the entire GTA community.

Spooky season is in full swing in GTA Online, bringing triple rewards on Halloween Survivals and Slasher Modes, in addition to double rewards on collecting Jack O’ Lanterns and UFO Business Battles.

Plus, hunting down phantasmal apparitions across San Andreas in Ghosts Exposed will pay out double GTA$.

Finally, the treats are lasting all month long: players will earn free Halloween apparel for playing GTA Online every week, in addition to a bonus GTA$2,000,000 for completing all of October’s weekly challenges.

Full details include:

  • 2X GTA$ and RP on Bail Office Targets, Dispatch Work, UFO Business Battles, and collecting Jack O’ Lanterns (through November 4)
  • 3X GTA$ and RP on the San Andreas Super Sport Series, Halloween Survivals, the Community Race Series, and Slasher modes (through November 4)
  • 2X GTA$ on Ghosts Exposed, alongside the Ghosts Exposed Jacket for photographing all 10 spirits
  • Return of the Clone Slasher, the Phantom Car, and Peyote Plants
  • Weekly Challenges:
    • Receive the Green Vintage Skull Mask and GTA$100,000 for completing two Bail Office Bounties (through October 7)
    • Receive the Pink Skull Emissive Mask and GTA$100,000 for winning in two Adversary modes (October 8-14)
    • Receive the Orange Glow Skeleton Onesie and GTA$100,000 for winning three Races (October 15–21)
    • Receive the Gray Space Interloper Outfit and GTA$150,000 for completing all waves of a Survival (October 22-28)
    • Receive the Slasher Clown Outfit and GTA$250,000 for completing 10 waves of a Survival without dying (October 29-November 4)
    • Receive GTA$2,000,000 for completing all weekly challenges
  • Free Halloween apparel for playing GTA Online:
    • Cheerleader Massacre 3 T-Shirt (through October 7)
    • Twilight Knife T-Shirt (October 8–14)
    • Butchery and Other Hobbies T-Shirt (October 15–21)
    • Tech Demon Mask (October 22–28)
    • Brown Vintage Skull Mask and the Halloween Chute Bag (October 29–November 4)
  • Vehicle Discounts:
    • 30% off the Declasse Vigero ZX, Sea Sparrow, Nagasaki Buzzard Attack Chopper, Lampadati Komoda, Western Powersurge, Benefactor Schlagen GT, Ocelot Ardent, Nagasaki Ultralight, and the Grotti Brioso 300 (through October 7)
    • 40% off the LCC Sanctus, Albany Brigham, Albany Lurcher, Albany Fränken Stange, and Declasse Tornado Rat Rod (through November 4)
  • GTA+ Members: Claim the Pegassi Horus through October 7, alongside the Pegassi Oppressor motorcycle with the Skulls livery and additional Halloween treats starting October 8.

Experience Halloween Thrills All Throughout October in GTA Online

The streets of Los Santos are crawling with creepy apparitions, paranormal visions, and more this Halloween season. Prepare for a month of ghastly mayhem with vengeful Slashers roaming the streets and tides of shambling undead occupying Ludendorff Cemetery.

Hunt down spooky visions of deceased tech executives for Ghosts Exposed and make a killing across the Halloween Featured Series, the kill-or-be-killed tension of Slasher, racing in the San Andreas Super Sport Series, or fighting off the forces of evil in Halloween Survivals. Plus, keep an eye out for Peyote Plants growing across Southern San Andreas to experience life from a whole new perspective. 

Work the Night Shift for Bonus Rewards

Step up and fight back against the shrouded agents of chaos lurking out there in the darkness. Apprehending Standard and Most Wanted Bail Office Targets or helping Vincent Effenburger clean up the streets in Dispatch Work will earn you 2X GTA$ and RP all October long.

Plus, tear through Random Transform Races and high-speed Hotring chaos for 3X GTA$ and RP in the San Andreas Super Sport Series.

Get Halloween Treats for Completing Weekly Challenges

Completing increasingly difficult Weekly Challenges throughout October will earn you special spooky gifts and cash rewards — with an extra GTA$2,000,000 bonus (delivered within 72 hours of completion) for achieving them all: 

  • October 1–7: Secure two Bail Office Bounties to get the Green Vintage Skull Mask and GTA$100,000 
  • October 8–14: Win in two Adversary modes to get the Pink Skull Emissive Mask and GTA$100,000 
  • October 15–21: Win three Races to get the Orange Glow Skeleton Onesie and GTA$100,000 
  • October 22–28: Complete all waves of a Survival to get the Gray Space Interloper Outfit and GTA$150,000 
  • October 29–November 4: Complete 10 waves in a Survival without dying to get the Slasher Clown Outfit and GTA$250,000 

3X GTA$ and RP for Halloween Survivals

The Ludendorff Cemetery Survival rises again this October, bringing waves of fearsome foes and haunted animals to bear down on frosty North Yankton.

All Halloween Survivals — including Alien Survivals, Cayo Perico Survival, and the ghastly Ludendorff Cemetery Survival — are awarding 3X GTA$ and RP.

Earn Triple in a Terrifying Community Race Series

Speed past chemical leaks, lava streams, and enflamed debris on the outskirts of the Zombie Town Circuit, along with other Halloween-themed additions to the Community Race Series,allpaying out 3X GTA$ and RP through November 4.

3X GTA$ and RP on Slasher Modes 

Embrace the darkness in the tension-filled Slasher mode, where a shotgun-wielding predator stalks their adversaries who are equipped only with flashlights. If they can survive for three minutes, the tables are turned.

Get 3X GTA$ and RP in all Slasher modes in the Featured Series — including the latest twist on this fan-favorite Halloween mode aboard the Ramius submarine.

Collect Free Halloween Apparel and Accessories

Playing GTA Online throughout the month will treat you to free items that can help you craft your Halloween costume, or your next disguise: 

  • October 1–7: Cheerleader Massacre 3 T-Shirt 
  • October 8–14: Twilight Knife T-Shirt 
  • October 15–21: Butchery and Other Hobbies T-Shirt 
  • October 22–28: White & Red Tech Demon Mask 
  • October 29–November 4: Brown Vintage Skull Mask and the Halloween Chute Bag

2X GTA$ on Ghosts Exposed

Prove the existence of the paranormal by photographing sprightly apparitions for Ghosts Exposed — including that of a particular late billionaire investor whose body was never found — to earn double GTA$.

Successfully photographing all 10 spirits will get you the Ghosts Exposed Jacket.

Returning Halloween Haunts

Wandering Los Santos and Blaine County after dark can be dangerous this time of year, but there are rewards for those brave enough to battle the creatures of the night, including the uncanny Clone Slasher and a driverless Declasse Tornado Custom with a thirst for blood. 

Collect Jack O’Lanterns, or extract Spaceship Parts from Fort Zancudo in UFO Business Battles to earn 2X GTA$ and RP. 

Halloween Discounts

Get discounted otherworldly vehicles including the LCC Sanctus, Albany Lurcher, and Albany Fränken Stange:

  • LCC Sanctus (Motorcycle) – 40% off 
  • Albany Brigham (Muscle) – 40% off 
  • Albany Lurcher (Muscle) – 40% off 
  • Albany Fränken Stange (Sports Classic) – 40% off 
  • Declasse Tornado Rat Rod (Sports Classic) – 40% off 

Additional Discounts: October 1–7 

  • Declasse Vigero ZX (Muscle) – 30% off 
  • Sea Sparrow (Helicopter) – 30% off 
  • Nagasaki Buzzard Attack Chopper (Helicopter) – 30% off 
  • Lampadati Komoda (Sport) – 30% off 
  • Western Powersurge (Motorcycle) – 30% off 
  • Benefactor Schlagen GT (Sports) – 30% off 
  • Ocelot Ardent (Sports Classic) – 30% off 
  • Nagasaki Ultralight (Plane) – 30% off 
  • Grotti Brioso 300 (Compact) – 30% off 

GTA+

GTA+ Members can still claim the flashy new Pegassi Horus supercar for free from The Vinewood Car Club through October 7. Beginning on October 8, Members can also claim a free Pegassi Oppressor motorcycle with the Skulls livery, along with additional Halloween treats and more. Look for details on these Halloween benefits at the Rockstar Newswire on October 8.

Grand Theft Auto V is currently available for PS4, PS5 , Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S and PC.
